result.label: bacta tank
result.description: An upright pressure cylinder of transparent duraplast, filled with bacta and fitted with a breathing mask and a suspension harness. A wounded body floats in it while the fluid does the work. Wounds and burns close many times faster than in any bed. Left in long enough, old scars and permanent injuries fade out, and damaged organs mend. It will not grow back what is gone — a missing limb or organ stays missing — and it does nothing at all for the brain or the mind. It needs power, and it needs bacta, and it drinks the bacta while it runs. RimStarWars — Bacta

result.label: medical droid
result.description: A squat, multi-limbed automaton bristling with surgical waldos and diagnostic sensors, parked on standby beside a bacta tank. It has no bedside manner and does not need one: while it is powered and within reach of an immersed patient, its constant micro-adjustments to dosage and posture measurably speed the tank's own work. It does nothing on its own — no tank, no patient, nothing to attend. RimStarWars — Bacta

result.label: bacta
result.description: A gelatinous, faintly luminous alkali fluid seeded with living bacteria. Immersed in it, a body's own repair goes into overdrive: wounds close in hours instead of weeks, and given enough time even old scarring is eaten away and replaced with sound tissue. It is not a medicine you can apply with your hands, and nobody here knows how to culture it. It arrives in sealed canisters on other people's ships, and it is expensive because it works. RimStarWars — Bacta

result.label: bacta patch
result.description: A self-adhesive dressing soaked in stabilized bacta gel. Peel it, press it over a fresh wound, and it goes to work immediately — nothing like the tank's slow, total-body immersion, but enough to close one bad cut before it becomes a bigger problem. It has nothing to offer an old scar, a missing limb, a damaged brain, or a disease already running its course. It is used once and gone. RimStarWars — Bacta

result.label: bacta spray
result.description: A pressurized canister of atomized bacta, meant to be misted over a whole wounded area rather than pressed onto one cut. It tends and closes every fresh wound it reaches, and its antiseptic base gives a treatable infection a real push toward beating itself — the closest a field item gets to the tank's own reach, in one burst instead of a slow immersion. Still just a dose: it cannot touch a scar, a missing limb, a damaged brain, or an infection medicine could never have helped anyway. RimStarWars — Bacta
